tools.name: teams_post_adaptive_card
tools.description: Post an Adaptive Card to an onboarded Teams channel (e.g., 'Plant A - Maintenance Planning Channel'), such as a weekly proposed-schedule summary or a re-optimization diff, with Approve/Modify action buttons. The bot may only post to channels it has been explicitly installed into by a Teams admin — never a tenant-wide broadcast. This is the human-approval gate for any downstream write-back to SAP PM or Outlook Calendar; the write-back tool must not be called until the corresponding card action is received.

tools.name: teams_send_direct_message
tools.description: Send a 1:1 direct message to a technician or shift supervisor, e.g., a task-assignment notification with checklist attached, or an escalation for an unstaffed resource-gap task.

tools.name: teams_get_card_action
tools.description: Poll for or receive the latest Adaptive Card action (Approve, Modify, Acknowledge, etc.) submitted against a previously posted card, correlated by conversation_id, so the workflow can proceed only after a human response.

tools.name: teams_get_free_text_reply
tools.description: Retrieve a free-text natural-language reply from a planner in an onboarded channel or direct message thread, for natural-language re-planning intent parsing.
